story.title: Git Is Breaking Under the Weight of AI Coding Agents Flooding GitHub With Commits
story.summary: The explosion of AI coding agents autonomously generating, committing, and merging code is pushing GitHub and the underlying Git version-control system to its architectural limits, with engineers warning the infrastructure was never designed for the volume or pace of machine-generated changes now hitting it. Developers report degraded performance, merge conflicts at unprecedented scale, and review queues that human engineers cannot keep up with. Industry observers say Git's decade-old design assumptions must be fundamentally rethought for an agentic coding world.
